craft_notes: Sthāyin: arc-joy (a..kṣa). Close: kind. Rejected: 'alphabet' — killed: forthgoing kept; 'patient' — killed at T1.

lines: Rootless, rightly ranged, to be known, to kṣa confined —
this forthgoing told, of every mantra and wisdom-kind.
l4.sanskrit_cite: amūlā tatkramā jñeyā kṣāntā sṛṣṭir udāhṛtā | sarveṣāṃ caiva mantrāṇāṃ vidyānāṃ ca yaśasvini

reads_against.argmap: Rootless, that-ordered, kṣa-ending emanation declared — of all mantras and wisdoms.
c1_essence: Rootless kṣa-ending emanation; of all mantras and wisdoms.
